message.content: Proposed 1 change — review the inline preview, then Accept or Reject.

patch.title: Standardize the unit notation in sections/samples.tex from the informal ASCII "um" to the proper SI symbol "µm" ($\mu$m) for all three samples; values 12/15/9 and sample identifiers A/B/C are unchanged.

hunks.oldText: Sample A has a thickness of 12 um. Sample B has a thickness of 15 um. Sample C has a thickness of 9 um.
hunks.newText: Sample A has a thickness of 12 $\mu$m. Sample B has a thickness of 15 $\mu$m. Sample C has a thickness of 9 $\mu$m.
